FX-DMATTE-001.says: As added: no layer named, so nothing changes.

FX-DMATTE-002.says: The plate as the difference layer, tolerance 15: every pixel the shot shares with the plate keyed out, the green subject kept whole, the clear corner clear.

FX-DMATTE-003.says: FX-DMATTE-002 as the matte: the subject white, the rest black, the clear corner clear.

FX-DMATTE-004.says: A plate 10 levels darker, tolerance 3: every difference is 3.92 per cent, above 3, so nothing is keyed and nothing changes.

FX-DMATTE-005.says: The darker plate, tolerance 5: 3.92 is within 5, so the background is keyed and only the subject stays.

FX-DMATTE-006.says: The darker plate, tolerance 2, softness 4: the background kept at (3.92 - 2) / 4, about 0.48, the subject whole.

FX-DMATTE-007.says: A grainy plate, 8 levels lighter and darker by turns, tolerance 2, no blur: every difference is 3.14 per cent, so nothing is keyed.

FX-DMATTE-008.says: The grainy plate, tolerance 2, softness 4, blurred at 1 before the difference: the blur smooths the grain away, so most of the background is keyed, while the subject and its edge stay.

FX-DMATTE-009.says: The plate, tolerance 5, softness 10, blurred at 1: the subject kept whole and a soft halo of the background around it, the rest keyed.

FX-DMATTE-010.says: The plate's middle 8 by 6 centred: it lies exactly where it was cut, so the background inside it is keyed; outside it the plate is clear, which differs from everything that shows, so that is kept.

FX-DMATTE-011.says: The middle 8 by 6 stretched to 16 by 10: it no longer lies on the shot, so far less is keyed.

FX-DMATTE-012.says: The holder names itself, tolerance 0: every pixel matches itself, so everything is keyed.

FX-DMATTE-013.says: A layer that is not in the composition, `gone`: nothing changes, and the warning every frame.

FX-DMATTE-014.says: The plate with its in point at frame 4: before it the plate is empty, clear, which differs from everything that shows, so at frame 0 nothing changes; at frame 4 it is FX-DMATTE-002.

FX-DMATTE-015.says: The darker plate, tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 10 at frame 4: frame 0 unchanged, frames 2 and 4 the background keyed.

FX-DMATTE-016.says: FX-DMATTE-006 on the holder moved 2 right and 1 down: the same picture moved, since the plate lies on the layer.

FX-DMATTE-017.says: The effect on an adjustment layer above the holder, the plate as its difference layer: the plate lies on the frame, which here is the holder's own rectangle, so this is FX-DMATTE-002.

FX-DMATTE-018.says: Tolerance 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-019.says: Tolerance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-020.says: Softness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-021.says: Blur 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-022.says: Blur -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-023.says: A view written "alpha". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-024.says: A fit written "tile", which After Effects' sizes do not offer. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-025.says: A layer written as the number 3, not a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DMATTE-026.says: Tolerance keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
